title: Legacy Text Input Contract Audit, TTUTIL Suitability & Adapter Qualification
qualification_scope: revision-53 input-family audit, defaults/error contracts, exact official TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance, strict legacy-versus-native adapter policy, bounded DIRECT/animo.ini representation qualification, and bounded non-GHG Ruurlo MATERIAL representation qualification with explicit runtime-hazard exclusions; no production input migration

legacy_undefined_behavior_exclusion.reason: revision-53 can form Fname(0:Ilast) when Istart remains zero and Ilast is positive

ttutil_numeric_policy.exact_candidate_transport: TTUTIL CHARACTER scalar/array numeric tokens plus adapter-owned REAL(8) conversion

runtime_hazard_exclusions: sparse FR/FRca omitted cells are read by revision 53 without identified explicit source initialization; intended zero semantics are lineage-qualified but the legacy storage mechanism is not
Pofr(Frno) is range-checked by revision 53 at IPO=0 after a zero-element implied-DO input and the checked runtime value is not input-defined

principal_findings: TTUTIL 4.27 source provenance is exact and hash-pinned from the supplied SWAP 4.3.1 distribution
the public SWAP-model/ttutil repository is not byte-identical to the official SWAP 4.3.1 embedded source and is reference-only
TTUTIL is useful parser infrastructure but is not a drop-in parser for the revision-53 legacy grammar
LegacyRevision53TextAdapter and TTUTILNativeTextAdapter/v1 are separate DIRECT representation contracts
Pilot A produces 10/10 field-exact LegacyInputBinding/v1 routing semantics on the natural frozen testbank
the natural Ruurlo old/full and revision-53 new/sparse MATERIAL files establish exact zero semantics for omitted sparse FR and FRca cells in the qualified lineage
Pilot B produces field-exact MaterialParameterSet/v1 semantics for the bounded non-GHG Ruurlo contract with no numeric tolerance
direct TTUTIL 4.27 DOUBLE parsing is rejected for field-exact MATERIAL representation because 26 Ruurlo numeric leaves differ by one binary64 ULP
the qualified MATERIAL candidate uses TTUTIL CHARACTER token transport with adapter-owned REAL(8) conversion so TTUTIL does not become numeric/scientific authority
two MATERIAL runtime-storage hazards remain explicitly excluded and routed to BUILDQ01/B3I01 rather than normalized away
ANIMO41 GENERAL remains sequentially order-sensitive and is not qualified by either pilot
INITIAL and restart state remain specialized state adapters
external crop and soil-temperature time series remain specialized forcing/exchange adapters
GHGMais remains lineage-sensitive; DIRECT routing equality does not qualify its GHG input schema
next_safe_steps: obtain final-head GitHub Actions confirmation for the expanded IO01 audit and MATERIAL unit tests
keep MAT-RH-001 and MAT-RH-002 routed to BUILDQ01/B3I01 and do not assign a local canonical TCD number
select any next text-input pilot independently, preferring another bounded non-GHG static contract or separately evidenced MATERIAL feature variant
keep GENERAL sequence-sensitive until its own strict legacy normalization is qualified
keep GHGMais and cross-lineage GHG fields outside generic MATERIAL admission
do not generalize Pilots A/B to SOIL, PLANT, management, restart or binary hydrology
